variant_statement: V05 TVF inner: the typed PIVOT accepts a deterministic SQL Server table-valued function as its inner source and applies the typed projection to it.

selector.matches: exactly T232VariantV05Tests (2 test methods); confirmed by `-list methods` on the current assembly

assertion_to_executed_test.assertion: A typed PIVOT over a table-valued-function inner emits the declared projection: the inner source renders as the aliased TVF call `t232_sales_tvf() as [t1]`, the PIVOT pivots it, and the typed members `[1] as [Q1]`, `[2] as [Q2]` are the frozen rename/order contract applied to that source.
assertion_to_executed_test.route: ctx.FromTableFunction(() => SalesTvf.Sales()) -> Pivot(PivotAggregate.Sum, r => r.Margin, r => r.Quarter, (r,pv) => new { r.Category, Q1 = pv.Value<decimal?>("1"), Q2 = pv.Value<decimal?>("2") }) -> Select(...) -> GetPreparedQueryCommand -> DbCommand.CommandText
assertion_to_executed_test.observed_output: the run passed, which asserts the emitted SQL equals exactly: "select category, [Q1], [Q2]\n from (select category, [1] as [Q1], [2] as [Q2]\n from t232_sales_tvf() as [t1] pivot (sum(margin) for quarter in ([1], [2])) as [t2]) as [t3]" (assertion at T232VariantClosureTests.cs:58-61)
assertion_to_executed_test.observed_run: dotnet run --project tests/nextorm.sqlserver.tests -c Debug --no-build -- -method NextORM.SqlServer.Tests.T232VariantV05Tests.TypedPivot_OverTvfInner_EmitsTheDeclaredProjection -> Total: 1, Failed: 0, exit 0

assertion_to_executed_test.assertion: A typed PIVOT over a TVF inner composes with a subsequent Where/Select: the statement still carries `from t232_sales_tvf() as [t1] pivot (sum(margin) for quarter in ([1])) as [t2]` and the outer filter renders `where (t3.[Q1] > cast(0 as decimal(38, 10)))`.
